summary: Iter33 verified the 4 changes: (1) emergentintegrations removal — backend starts cleanly, _ai_text uses AsyncOpenAI with graceful HTTP 400 when OPENAI_API_KEY is unset, send_email uses stdlib smtplib and no-ops when SMTP_HOST unset so /api/auth/forgot-password returns 200. (2) Public gallery — /api/public/gallery-file/{path} serves settings-whitelisted images without auth (200), and the public /galeri route shows a 'Galeri Sekolah' section (data-testid=public-school-gallery) using those URLs. (3) Bulk quiz import — POST /api/quizzes/parse-file correctly parses CSV + XLSX, maps header 'Jawaban' to answer index with letter (A->0, B->1), text match (option text 'Asia' -> correct index), and preserves 'in opts' precedence over numeric-looking strings (options ['1','2','3','4'], answer '4' -> index 3 via text match). Frontend NewQuizModal 'Impor Excel/CSV' (quiz-import-input) populated 2 questions from CSV and saved. (4) Image crop — ImageCropDialog (data-testid=image-crop-dialog) with zoom slider (crop-zoom) opens for both Settings 'B. Logo Sekolah' (round, aspect 1:1) and SchoolInfo 'Ganti Foto Sampul' (aspect 16:7). Clicking 'Gunakan' (crop-confirm) uploads and updates preview; Simpan persists. 7/7 backend tests PASS, 4/4 frontend flows PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4579 lines — splitting into domain modules (ai, settings, quizzes, uploads, auth) would significantly improve maintainability. This has been flagged in prior iterations.
/api/public/gallery-file whitelist is rebuilt per-request from settings on every GET — fine for current scale, but if gallery grows large consider caching the allow-set.
_ai_text sets temperature/max_tokens hardcoded — move to module constants or settings for easier tuning.
seed_data_creation: Created a temp quiz 'TEST_ImportedQuiz_iter33' via UI, 1 temp gallery image, and 1 temp hero image upload. Teardown: deleted the quiz and reset settings.gallery_images to []. hero_image_url remains populated with the test-uploaded cover (benign — hero is a single-image field that always needs a value; prior iterations also leave it set).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iter33_openai_bulk_public.py covers: public /api/settings exposes gallery_images; AI graceful 400 when OPENAI_API_KEY unset; /api/auth/forgot-password graceful 200 with no SMTP; /api/quizzes/parse-file CSV (letter/text/numeric answer normalization) + XLSX + empty-file rejection; /api/public/gallery-file 404 before referenced, 200 after whitelisting via PATCH /api/settings. Note: PATCH not PUT for /api/settings. Note: direct Python-urllib GETs to the preview host are 403'd by the ingress WAF — use `requests` or set a browser-like User-Agent. Frontend flows exercised: Quizzes NewQuizModal CSV import, SettingsPage logo crop (round 1:1), SchoolInfo hero crop (16:7), SchoolInfo gallery upload, and incognito /galeri verifying 'public-school-gallery' section + /api/public/gallery-file/ src loads 200.
